title: Law to require free abortion pills at all city sexual health clinics
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to make medication abortion available at no cost at every sexual health clinic it operates, not just the four clinics that currently offer it. Currently only the Fort Greene, Jamaica, Morrisania and Central Harlem clinics provide this medication, which served 1,253 patients in 2025. The requirement would be subject to sufficient city funding and would take effect July 1, 2029.
